caption: A white ball on a white table is lit by a red lamp from the left and a blue lamp from the right, and it casts a blue-tinted shadow on one side and a red-tinted shadow on the other.

sa.check: A ball is on a table.
A red lamp lights it from one side and a blue lamp from the other.
It casts a blue-tinted shadow on one side and a red-tinted shadow on the other.
The ball and the table are white.
The red lamp is on the left and the blue lamp on the right.

pc.expect: The shadow cast by blocking the red lamp is lit only by the blue lamp and looks blue, and vice versa.
pc.fail: Both shadows are grey; or the shadows have swapped colours; or a shadow is a colour neither lamp gives.

pc.expect: Each coloured shadow lies away from its own lamp, and switching off one lamp would remove its shadow's colour.
pc.fail: A shadow lies toward its lamp; or both shadows are on the same side; or a shadow keeps its colour with its lamp off.

pc.expect: Each shadow keeps the ball's round outline.
pc.fail: A shadow is a different shape; or splits; or the two merge into one.

pc.expect: The ball and the lamps stay put.
pc.fail: The ball rolls; or a lamp moves by itself; or a shadow drifts.
The ball duplicates; or a lamp vanishes; or a shadow becomes solid.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The table and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The table changes; or the room rearranges; or the ball changes size.
